In the meeting held on March 18, 2020, the Board of Directors had approved that the Company may acquire up to 19% of equity shares in Hinduja Leyland Finance Limited ( HLFL ) from existing shareholders in HLFL in tranches for a consideration not exceeding Rs.1200 Crores subject to such approvals, consents, sanctions and permissions of the appropriate authorities, as may be necessary. Ashok Leyland Ltd considers HLFL a very significant subsidiary for financing its vehicles like all OEMs in the automotive sector.  The Board continues to believe that the proposal to raise the shareholding in HLFL was consistent with the philosophy to prevent any future dilution based on HLFL s growth plans.  In addition, the objective was to simplify the holding structure to make HLFL ready for future capital raises from financial investors. However, in a meeting held today, the Board of Directors of Ashok Leyland, after considering the feedback on the proposal from minority stakeholders, decided to restrict the acquisition of shares by Ashok Leyland to 6.99% of the paid-up capital of HLFL at a price of Rs.119/- per share aggregating to Rs.390.49 Crores from Everfin Holdings (an affiliate of Everstone Capital) and Hinduja Group who had purchased the initial tranches of HLFL shares from Everfin. This arrangement would result in Ashok Leyland acquiring both directly and indirectly the residual 6.99% stake of Everfin at a price of Rs.119/- per share, as per the agreement entered with them earlier this year.  On completion of aforementioned transaction, the stake of the Company in HLFL will increase by 6.99% from 61.83% to 68.82%.

Ashok Leyland Ltd has informed the Exchange regarding a press release which is as follows:- Hinduja Group flagship Ashok Leyland announced its plans to set up a vehicle manufacturing unit in Uttaranchal. An investment of over Rs. 1000 crores will create vehicle assembly and cab facility to produce 25,000 vehicles annually, which will be stepped to 40,000 nos. eventually. About 200 acres of land has been identified in Pant Nagar for this purpose. The unit will create employment for 3000 people. Explaining the rationale for selecting the site, said Mr. R Seshasayee, Managing Director. "This unit will strengthen our presence in Northern India which already contributes nearly a quarter of our sales. The development of Uttaranchal as an auto hub made our selection easier." The investments will enjoy excise duty exemption and income tax exemption / concession for five / ten years.

News Verification : The media had reports that Ashok Leyland Ltd is planning to set up a vehicle manufacturing facility in Uttranchal with an investment of over Rs. 1,000 crore. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the media and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company. Ashok Leyland Ltd has vide its letter inter-alia stated, "We confirm the correctness of the news."

Ashok Leyland Ltd has informed the Exchange that at the meeting held on July 26, 2005, Mr. Steve Young has been appointed as a Director of the Company.

Clarification of News : The press had reports that Ashok Leyland Limited is poised to get significant number of orders from some African Countries. The Exchange, in order to verify the accuracy or otherwise of the information reported in the press and to inform the market place so that the interest of the investors is safeguarded, had written to the officials of the company. Ashok Leyland Ltd has informed the Exchange that the Register of Members and Share Transfer Registers will be closed from July 09, 2005 to July 26, 2005 for the purpose of the AGM to be held on July 26, 2005 and to declare Dividend.

Ashok Leyland Ltd has informed the Exchange that at the meeting held on April 28, 2005, the BOD's of the Company have recommended a dividend of 100% on the equity shares of the Company, for the year 2004-2005.

Ashok Leyland Ltd has submitted the minutes of the EGM held on March 05, 2005. The details of the minutes of EGM shall be available on the NSE website (http://www.nseindia.com) under: Corporates > Latest Announcements and on the Extranet Server (/Common/CorporateAnnouncements).

Ashok Leyland Ltd has informed the Exchange of the following: (1) At a Board Meeting held on March 05, 2005, (a) the BOD's of the Company have approved the sale of the Ductron Castings Unit (DCU) of the Company to the Company's associate company M/s Ennore Foundries Limited (EFL) on a "going concern" basis. The valuation for the Unit has been carried out by M/s Price Waterhouse Coopers and had been negotiated and finalized by an empowered Board Committee consisting of all the independent Directors. The total sale consideration of Rs.62 crores will be payable by EFL in cash. It is proposed to effect the sale and transfer of the DCU not later than July 2005. (b) Mr. P N Ghatalia has been appointed as a Director of the Company, to join the Board, effective April 01, 2005.  (2) The shareholders of the Company at the EGM held on March 05, 2005, pursuant to the Notice issued on January 29, 2005 have unanimously approved the proposed sale of DCU to EFL for the sale consideration referred above.

Ashok Leyland Ltd has informed the Exchange that Ashok Leyland Limited (ALL) has promoted a new company Ashley Transport Services Limited (ATSL) to provide information exchange and integrated logistic services to handle the business of freight contractors etc. These services are intended to enhance the customer relationships with transport operators which will support the long-term business development for ALL. Ashok Leyland Limited (ALL) has subscribed Rs.7 crores (700000 shares of Rs.100/- each at par), to the equity capital of Ashley Transport Services Limited (ATSL). These shares, which were allotted on November 16, 2004, represent 70% of the paid-up capital of ATSL, making ATSL a subsidiary company of ALL w.e.f. November 16, 2004.
